publication issues.summary: Current690 b0 converter invoked with Python -I -S -B -X utf8, explicit baseline model and text, --render --allow-partial and report. Exit 0, converted with findings: 24 blocks, 70 terminals, 30 nets, no formal uncertainties, 36 unresolved render differences all on row 68. The source output caption and line at x205–244 are absent from V4 render; native registered crop shows AP791 +HALF SUM ERROR 04–07 AZ4. No source movement or guessed repair. Paired V4/review/TXT/report retained and unapproved; digest matches sidecar. External schema not run. Raw restored deterministically from copied model, not independent acquisition; V3 projection matches explicit text and there are no source edits (inverse identity). Native overview and row68 crop viewed; 12 overlapping native tiles generated but not individually inspected. All 138 sectional panels and 30 point panels viewed on baseline block fit (47/48 inliers, median 2.27 pixels), no independent edge fit or separate refit. Local registration offsets, especially left bends and branch diamonds, limit interpretation. Same-named candidate composite uses baseline block fit, not independent edge registration. Local panels are not proof of complete wiring, ownership, or absence of omissions. Caption discrepancy and source/render differences remain open. The private V4 is not installed or approved.
